text:
anna_marketing: Hey team — draft of the Dedicated launch blog is up: https://docs.redwood.com/drafts/dedicated-launch-v1.md :point_right: Can people review copy + benchmarks today? We want to lock by EOD so eng can sign off on numbers.

sam_product: reading now. Quick flag — the latency number for p99 on the Dedicated config looks like it's from the internal perf run (batching=4). Should we call out the batching assumptions or use cold-start numbers? :thinking:

anna_marketing: good catch. I added a parenthetical about batching. Can you confirm the p50/p99 we should publish?

sam_product: publish p50=28ms, p99=210ms for Dedicated (GPU A100, batching=4, seq=512). Add note: "measurements taken on reserved pool under sustained load".

jordan_design: Heads up on hero — the current hero image uses the old console UI. Can I swap to the new Console screenshot and a simplified graph instead? Will make it feel more product-y. :camera_flash:

anna_marketing: yes please. Keep text overlay minimal. Also adding a short pull quote from the benchmark section right below hero.

lee_growth: For subject lines + promo emails: options — "Run LLMs at predictable cost with Redwood Dedicated", "Deterministic LLM performance for production apps". My pick is the first. Also, SEO tags: dedicated inference, low latency llm serving, inference cost optimization.

anna_marketing: noted. I'll use your subject line. Can someone propose the CTA for the end — schedule demo vs try Dedicated? We want to route inbound leads properly.

sam_product: CTA: "Request a Dedicated trial" -> routes to /sales/leads?source=blog_dedicated. Use UTM params. Also add a checkbox for "enterprise SLAs" on the form.

lee_growth: UTM snippet: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch` — and add `utm_content=cta_request_trial`. Also recommend setting lead_source=blog_dedicated in the webhook payload so Sales can auto-segment.

anna_marketing: @publish-bot can you remind ops to set the inbound webhook to POST to Sales at sales-webhook.redwood.com and include lead_source param?

publish-bot: scheduled reminder set for 2024-06-20T15:00Z to ping #sales with webhook details.

taylor_ceo: Tone check — keep technical but accessible. Emphasize predictable economics and reliability over raw bench numbers. One sentence near top: "Predictable latency and cost for production LLMs."

anna_marketing: will weave that in as the opening sentence.

sam_product: small technical edit in the benchmarks section: change "2x throughput" to "~2x throughput" since it's workload-dependent.

jordan_design: uploaded new hero in the doc (see assets section). Also tightened mobile spacing.

anna_marketing: thanks all. Final checklist: copy locked by 18:00 PT, hero updated, p50/p99 numbers confirmed, CTA + UTM set, inbound webhook + lead_source param documented for Sales, and legal to sign off on benchmarks — @sam_product can you validate legal wording?

sam_product: will run it by Legal and confirm by 16:00 PT. :white_check_mark:

anna_marketing: perfect. Once Legal replies I'll push the final to production and schedule the post + webinar invite for next Thursday. Planning a short webinar follow-up — anyone want to host?

lee_growth: I can host growth side, maybe cohost with an engineer to take live Qs.

sam_product: happy to cohost for Q&A.

anna_marketing: awesome. I'll update the promo calendar and create the event page after legal sign-off. Thanks everyone :tada:
